name: reader-001
description: Paste an article URL, get a clean reader view - no images, no ads, just text.

scripts.build: pkg . --target node22-win-x64 --output dist/Reader.exe && node_modules\rcedit\bin\rcedit-x64.exe dist/Reader.exe --set-icon Reader.ico && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('Reader.vbs','dist/Reader.vbs')"
